description: Email an athlete their invitation, as the Share dialog's "Email the invitation" button does: a link to their plan, from the coach (replies go to the coach). They open it, sign in once, and the plan is theirs; it also tells them to connect their watch. Works again later as a reminder, once a day at most. Needs an email address on the athlete (update_athlete sets one). note: an optional line from the coach, shown at the top.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

note.description: Optional personal line from the coach

name: send_athlete_invite
